successors.note: Umar Tall seized Nioro, the capital, in April 1855 (Toucouleur Empire and Umar Tall pages); the Kaarta page says 1854. Archinard conquered the former kingdom in 1890 and France annexed it in 1904.

ledger.note: c. 1650: Massa founds the Bambara kingdom of Kaarta. Infobox "Founded c. 1650 by Massa, who ruled 1650-1710"; "Preceded by the Songhai Empire".

1754: the Coulibaly take over from the Massassi. Foulakoro (1745-1754) was captured and defeated by Bitòn Coulibaly; "Sey Bamana Coulibaly, who had fled Segou in 1754, re-establishes Kaarta" (1754-58).

region.text: Diarra (Diara), the Bambara-speaking country east of Kaarta (the page gives no location; a disc in the Nara country)

ledger.note: 1777: Sira Bo makes Diarra a vassal. "1777: Sira Bo vassalizes Diarra"; he also vassalised Khasso and raided Beledougou and Bambuk (no dates).

region.text: Diarra (Diara), the Bambara-speaking country east of Kaarta (the page gives no location; a disc in the Nara country)

ledger.note: 1855: Diarra's tie to Kaarta ends with the kingdom. No page dates the end; it is bridged to the fall of Kaarta.

region.text: Kaarta round Nioro du Sahel and Diangounté (the page gives no outline; Diafunu is inside the disc)

ledger.note: April 1855: Umar Tall takes Kaarta. "1854: Umar Tall's jihad destroys Kaarta as an independent force. He seizes Nioro and executes Faama Mamady Kandian and his family, ending the Massassi dynasty." The Toucouleur Empire page dates the seizure of Nioro to April 1855.

region.text: Kaarta round Nioro du Sahel and Diangounté (the page gives no outline; Diafunu is inside the disc)

ledger.note: April 1855: Kaarta ends with the execution of its last faama, Mamady Kandian. The Kaarta page has the year 1854; the Toucouleur and Umar Tall pages April 1855 (followed so that the two dossiers meet).

wars.name: Kaarta-Segu wars
wars.outcome: Benefali (1710-1745) "fought a long war against Bitòn Coulibaly and the Segou Empire" (no years given); Foulakoro (1745-1754) was captured by Bitòn Coulibaly; Sey Bamana Coulibaly, who fled Segou in 1754, re-established Kaarta. Desse Koro was later defeated by Mansong Diarra of Segu (no date).

wars.name: Umar Tall's conquest of Kaarta

zones.text: Kaarta round Nioro du Sahel and Diangounté (the page gives no outline; Diafunu is inside the disc)

wars.outcome: Umar Tall's jihad took Nioro and ended the Massassi dynasty; the Bambara kingdom became the Tukulor Empire's second capital province.
wars.note: Year 1854 on the Kaarta page, April 1855 on the Toucouleur Empire page.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier; Kaarta is a disc round Nioro.

sources.title: Kaarta

notes:
Kaarta (Bambara kingdom of Kaarta, Massassi then Coulibaly), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Kaarta (1 page; a second page would be the Bamana Empire or Segou pages).

Conflicts: the end is 1854 (Kaarta page) or April 1855 (Toucouleur Empire and Umar Tall pages, used); founding c. 1650 (infobox) while the standard dating of the Coulibaly kingdom is 1754: the dossier starts c. 1650 and records 1754 as a rename. The Tukulor dossier records the same seizure in April 1855. Not on the page: an area or outline; Khasso's vassalage under Sira Bo (1761-1781); Bambuk raids; Desse Koro's defeat by Mansong; the rulers 1781-1818. Diarra's position is a coordinate disc east of Kaarta (not in the gazetteer).
Counterparts: diarra (Diarra kingdom, no dossier), bamana-empire (exists), tukulor-empire (this batch), songhai-empire (exists). Gazetteer: Kaarta, Diangounté, Diarra, Khasso.
